    The walk construction as a controlled embedding #

    Alternative (3) of Theorem 3.10 in data form. Walk.WalkData k A consists of a presentation π : kQ → A (a surjective algebra homomorphism) and a primitive walk, given by its cycle D_w with a source and the map p : D_w → Q satisfying (3.4), such that p_*L(T) (Construction 3.9) is an A-module for every T ∈ D_fin. It gives push-down data (PushDown.PdData): the classes of block positions are the components of the matching quiver (Lemma 4.6), and a morphism φ with L(φ) vanishing at a vertex is zero by Lemma 2.2(1). With the sink convention, the facts about S₋ used in Theorem 2.7 holds automatically (WalkData.toPdDatum), so walk data alone yield a controlled embedding.
